AuthorDetails.Name: ProWorks Corporation
AuthorDetails.Description: ProWorks Corporation is an Umbraco Platinum Partner based in the USA. We have been building and maintaining Umbraco implementations since the early versions of the platform, certified across Umbraco 4 through 17, and we have three Umbraco MVPs on staff. We work with organizations across many industries including credit unions, insurers, public agencies (federal, state, and local), travel, healthcare, higher education, and manufacturers. Our approach is consultative: we will meet you where you are and recommend the right next step, even if that means doing less.

Description: Adds an "Evaluate Page" step to Umbraco Automate for the ProWorks Umbraco.AI Page Evaluator. The step evaluates the latest saved version of a page with its active evaluator configuration and outputs the score, a pass/fail verdict, check counts, a summary and an email-ready HTML report in 10 languages, so you can build review-before-release and publish-if-passing flows. Requires the ProWorks Umbraco.AI Page Evaluator package and Umbraco Automate 17.5.1+.
Title: ProWorks Umbraco.AI Page Evaluator - Automate

RelatedPackages.Description: Required: the Page Evaluator itself. Adds an Evaluate Page button that scores the page against your own AI checks, with recommendations you can apply, Copilot tools and an agent tool.
Umbraco Deploy support: evaluator configurations move between environments with their AI profile and context.
